# Project plan

## Start-up phase
<!--
Covering the planning phase, this section should provide a relatively
detailed plan of how work will start on the project. This section is
important because projects need to get up and running quickly.


 - [ ] Setting up collaboration platform inc. code for contributors etc.
 - [ ] License decisions
 - [ ] Reporting framework
-->

The open-source R package, under GPL licence, is aimed at establishing the GitHub repository and integrating it with the local machine workflows. The system's architectural design and defining of the initial abstract classes will be the first priority.


## Technical delivery
<!--
Covering the actual delivery of the project this section should
provide at least a high-level description of the implementation.

Including target dates is really important as you need to be committed
and the ISC need to have a means of tracking delivery
-->

Procedure for continuous integration, stakeholder feedback and updates by R Core teams are in place after package deployment to GitHub and CRAN repositories.

## Budget & funding plan

<!--
Note that the maximum grant is $10k USD. The proposal should be in USD.

Outline the milestones for development and how much funding will be
required for each stage (as payments will be tied to project milestone
completion). This also helps the ISC in the event of partial funding. 
Each milestone should specify the work to be done and the
expected outcomes, providing enough detail for the ISC to understand
the scope of the project work and assess the likelihood of success.

We expect that most of the budget will be allocated
for labor costs. We do not cover indirect costs. The ISC grants cannot
cover such things as travel, lodging, food, journal publication fees,
or personal hardware. Cloud services may be covered if they are specific
to the project and the project period. The ISC reserves the right to vet
how funds are used for each project separately. If in doubt, please reach
out to us.

In line with the above timelines, the budget propsed for this project is USD8500 appropriated as follows:

Inception and take-off (USD1500): Funds 30 hours of core development work at a rate of USD50/hour covering GitHub setup and integration with local machine codes.

Coding and testing (USD5000): Funds 100 hours of setting up functions and algorithms, and documentation (website and GitHub repositories). Initial submission to CRAN.

Sensitization workshop(USD1000): Sensitization workshop and stakeholder engagement for faculty and students at Federal University of Technology, Minna. Publicity over social media handles.

Final release  and closure (USD1000): Funds 20 hours for incorporating views from stakeholders into the package, responding to CRAN reviews and comments, cleaning up the package and final release to CRAN.

Preliminary release and initial CRAN submission  | 2     | Comprehensive package documentation, website hosting, initial CRAN submission, and host a community webinar  | 1000

-->

Milestone     | Duration (weeks)[1] | Deliverable/Tangible Products | Budget (USD)
------------- | -------------  | ---------------------------------- | --------- 
Inception and take-off  | 3     | Establish GitHub repository and local machine integration. Complete core system architecture design and initial abstract class definitions | 1500
Coding and testing  | 10    | Set up functions and transformation algorithms. Build the documentation website and GitHub pages. Pass integration tests with local memory backends and prepare the initial CRAN submission package | 5000
Sensitization Workshop  | concurrently with _Testing and Coding_    | Conduct a sensitization workshop and stakeholder engagement for faculty and students at the Federal University of Technology, Minna. Drive publicity over social media handles | 1000
Final release  and closure | 2 | Incorporate stakeholder engagement feedback, resolve CRAN review comments, clean up repository branches, and achieve official final release on CRAN | 1000
Total | 15 |  | 8500
[1] 10 hours are devoted per week
